sections.heading: Auto-Rendered Quiz
sections.content: When you add a `quiz` block to your post frontmatter, it automatically renders before the signup CTA. No additional code needed.

sections.heading: Explicit Inline Placement
sections.content:
If you want to place the quiz at a specific location in your post, use:

```
<InlineQuiz slot="quiz" />
```

This allows you to control where the quiz appears, rather than relying on the auto-placement.

sections.heading: Quiz Modes
sections.content:
**Practice Mode** (default)
- Users get instant feedback on each answer
- Score updates live
- Explanations display automatically on correct answers
- Ideal for learning and understanding concepts

**Exam Mode**
- Selections are stored silently
- No feedback until submit
- Shows "Submit Answers" button
- Reveals all results and explanations at once
- Best for testing knowledge

sections.heading: Timer
sections.content:
Add a `timeLimit` (in seconds) to enable a countdown timer:

```yaml
quiz:
  title: "Timed Quiz"
  mode: "exam"
  timeLimit: 300  # 5 minutes
  questions: [...]
```

Timer starts on first user selection and auto-submits when time runs out.

sections.heading: No-JavaScript Fallback
sections.content: Even without JavaScript, readers can click "Answer Key (no JavaScript)" to see all correct answers and explanations. This ensures accessibility and usability for all users.

sections.heading: Draft vs Publish
sections.content:
- **Draft**: Article saved but NOT visible to readers. Use this while writing and editing.
- **Published**: Article is live and visible on the blog.

sections.heading: Check Before Publishing
sections.content:
1. Verify title clearly describes the content
2. Check description is concise (meta tags)
3. Ensure correct cluster/category is selected
4. Review tags for consistency
5. Proofread body content
6. Test any interactive elements (quiz, CTAs)

sections.heading: Publishing Steps
sections.content:
1. Complete all article content
2. Set Draft toggle to OFF
3. Click Save
4. Article goes live within minutes

sections.heading: Unpublishing
sections.content:
To remove an article from the blog:
1. Open the article
2. Set Draft toggle to ON
3. Click Save

Article will be hidden from readers but content is preserved.

sections.heading: Static-First Principle
sections.content:
All blog posts are static MDX files. Content is code. This means:
- No dynamic content fetching
- All data computed at build time
- Performance-optimized by default

sections.heading: Metadata Requirements
sections.content:
**Title**: Clear, descriptive, SEO-friendly
**Description**: 1-2 sentences for meta tags
**Date**: Publication date
**Author**: Default is "ChampionsPrep"
**Tags**: Relevant keywords (comma-separated)
**Cluster**: Select the appropriate category

sections.heading: Editorial Standards
sections.content:
- Use clear, accessible language
- Break content into digestible sections
- Include examples where helpful
- Maintain consistent tone (educational, friendly)
- Proofread before publishing

sections.heading: Approved Components
sections.content:
You can use these interactive elements:
- InlineQuiz (for learning assessments)
- ExamTip (callout boxes)
- SignupCTA (newsletter signup)
- TableOfContents (auto-generated)

Do NOT add custom components without approval.
